description: Claude Code's hooks report approvals and questions. A screen rule recognizes its pre-hook folder trust prompt; the other rules read the title.

rules.why: Claude Code's folder trust menu asks for confirmation before hooks can report the approval.

all.regex:
^.{0,32}Quick safety check[^
]*
[\s\S]*^.{0,32}Yes, I trust this folder[ 	]*
[\s\S]*^.{0,64}Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel.{0,32}(?![\s\S])

rules.why: Claude Code prefixes its title with ✳ at rest, but the glyph can stay up while a turn still paints, so the screen must also be quiet.
Claude Code animates a braille or quarter-circle spinner frame in its title while a turn runs.
